title: Data migration failure with liability cap
description: Cloudharbour migrated our client records to a new CRM over the weekend of 17 May 2025. About 3,000 records were corrupted. We spent around £60,000 on contractors to rebuild them from backups and paper files. Cloudharbour point to a clause limiting their liability to the fees we paid, which were £5,000.
notes: Tests whether the liability cap is extracted as a term that a solicitor must address.
